scripts.docker:build: sh -c '_I=$IMAGE; _P=$PLATFORM; set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; IMAGE=${_I:-$IMAGE}; PLATFORM=${_P:-$PLATFORM}; set -x; docker build --platform ${PLATFORM:-linux/amd64} -t ${IMAGE:-hydrawise-proxy}:$npm_package_version -t ${IMAGE:-hydrawise-proxy}:latest .'
scripts.docker:push: sh -c '_I=$IMAGE; set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; IMAGE=${_I:-$IMAGE}; set -x; docker push ${IMAGE:-hydrawise-proxy}:$npm_package_version && docker push ${IMAGE:-hydrawise-proxy}:latest'
scripts.deploy: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:push
